findings.claim: Bluebeam documents an open multi-segment measurement made by selecting each point, removing the last control point with Backspace, and finishing with Enter. Subject and Label retain descriptive text on measurement records/markups.

support.section: Open-perimeter description, label and point-entry instructions

findings.applicability: A documented interaction example for point-by-point polyline correction and deliberate completion. Keyboard/UI design remains a Heleos implementation choice.
implementation_guidance: Show each retained path vertex so a correction can preserve intermediate bends.
Support explicit finish and last-point removal during path entry.
Associate correction descriptions with their source-linked result.
verification_to_add: Edit an intermediate polyline vertex and recalculate the affected portion.
Cancel an incomplete edit without changing saved evidence or quantities.

findings.claim: Bluebeam says control-point changes update a measurement, in an example specifically about curved area markups.

support.section: Take a curved measurement: area example

findings.applicability: Supports edit-and-update feedback as a software interaction example only. It does not establish validated duct curve measurement or permit straight substitutes for curves.
implementation_guidance: Recalculate supported changed geometry while retaining prior result evidence.
Keep unsupported curve/flex geometry unresolved under D03.

findings.claim: MEPdetect explicitly states that missed symbols are absent from counts, untraceable runs are absent from netlists, and measured lengths depend on calibration. Its exports include drawing overlays/reports; YOLOplan describes annotated-image and tabular outputs.
findings.applicability: Documents detector/tracer limitations and static source visualization, not an auditable correction model. Supports explicit partial coverage and a way to capture missed observations against the drawing.
implementation_guidance: Let a reviewer add a missed portion with retained page/region evidence.
Do not equate successful inference or corrected visible portions with complete coverage.
Keep the original source and previous quantities accessible after correction.
not_inferred: Requirement for the user to perform the whole takeoff first

implementation_guidance: Split only at a supported size/group change and retain shared source lineage.

findings.claim: MEPdetect describes following a same-tag electrical circuit across a matchline and counting it once.
findings.applicability: A domain-specific electrical tracing description. Matching tags alone cannot establish physical duct correspondence under approved D08.
implementation_guidance: Keep split/replacement provenance separate from physical-duplicate correspondence.
Do not collapse distinct duct portions solely because labels match.
